design_notes: Slowest, least agile ship in the fleet - trades all mobility for mining equipment and ore capacity.
Smaller crew than Steadfast (2 vs 3), but role is specialised (mining) not general cargo.

Blocked on gameplay design, not on art: needs the economy/mining mechanic designed first (see Gamespace_ReferenceLibrary_Plan.md topic 4) so we know what equipment the ship actually needs to carry. Do not start the 3D pipeline before that exists.
